title: Bourgain's $L^2$ pointwise ergodic theorem over function fields
summary: We prove a function-field analogue of Bourgain's $L^2$ pointwise ergodic theorem. Let $q$ be a power of a prime $p$, let $\mathbb{F}_q[t]$ be the ring of polynomials over the finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$, and let $\mathbb{F}_q[t][u]$ be the ring of polynomials over $\mathbb{F}_q[t]$. Let $T^{(1)},\ldots,T^{(\ell)}$ be commuting, measure-preserving $\mathbb{F}_q[t]$-actions on a $σ$-finite measure space $(X,μ)$, and let $P_1,\ldots,P_\ell\in \mathbb{F}_q[t][u]\setminus\{0\}$.
